resources.string: Change paired phone
The transfer happens on the watch and the new phone. This phone only starts it and, at the very end, clears its own record.

Until the watch has completely finished pairing with the new phone, don’t unpair from this phone or forget the watch in its Bluetooth settings. Doing so early can make the transfer fail or leave this phone’s Bluetooth record behind.
The watch isn’t connected. Steps 1 and 2 need it connected to this phone.
Check the watch first
Reads the watch’s service version and compares it with the version this app was verified on. Nothing on the watch changes.
Check watch support
This watch runs the verified version
This watch doesn’t run the verified version
Wear OS 3.5 can’t move to a new phone and keep its data.
The watch connection changed during the check. Check again once it’s stable.
The watch didn’t report its service version in time. Try again later.
Couldn’t read the watch’s service version. Try again later.
Finish on the watch and new phone

Once it’s open, finish everything on the watch and the new phone, including confirming the pairing code. Then check that the watch is back on its watch face, the new phone stays connected and health sync has resumed.
Open transfer on watch
Transfer opened on the watch. Finish all of it on the watch and the new phone.
Clean up this phone afterwards
Once the watch has ended its association, this phone stops reconnecting, but its Bluetooth record may remain. Clear it here; nothing is sent to the watch.
Clear this phone’s pairing
The watch is still connected to this phone, so the transfer may not be finished. You can clear this once that connection ends.
The watch has ended its association with this phone. You can clear its pairing now.

The watch isn’t connected to this phone, so nothing is sent to it. Continuing stops reconnection and removes this phone’s Bluetooth pairing and association. Health records on this phone stay.\n\nMake sure the watch has completely finished pairing with the new phone, or the transfer may fail.

The watch has ended its association with this phone. Continuing stops reconnection and removes this phone’s Bluetooth pairing and association. Nothing is sent to the watch, and health records on this phone stay.
This phone’s pairing was cleared.
This phone’s pairing wasn’t cleared. The watch may have reconnected; try again later.
Local cleanup did not finish. Open system Bluetooth settings, forget this watch, then check the watch before pairing again.
